title: TimelineEventInfo
description: Timeline event row for a world's per-branch timeline (GET /v1/daemon/worlds/:world_id/timeline/events). Maps 1:1 to a narrative_timeline_events row: typed columns stay authoritative, extensions carries the parsed extensions_nexus_json namespace (compute provenance etc.).

branch_id.description: Fork branch ID this event belongs to (root branch or specific fork).

event_type.description: Event type. Machine-written log families (e.g. compute_result) and author event types share this column.

status.description: Event status; only canon is merged into the Narrative layer projection.

affected_key_block_ids.description: KnowledgeEntry entry_ids affected by this event.

caused_by_event_ids.description: Timeline event ids that caused this one.

extensions.description: Parsed extensions_nexus_json namespace — carries compute provenance (module_id, module_version, run_id, source_kind) and any future extension keys.

modules.description: Per-event functional-dialect modules (modules.observation) carried verbatim from narrative_timeline_events.modules_json. Null when unrecorded (V1.164 P3, AR-2).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event creation.
